evidence_note: Offline fit against recorded calibration frames; model numbers are not CCD acceptance and no hardware was commanded.

shaping.note: Only already-recorded flat/net calibration frames were read. No closed-loop shaping, no new commands, no phase updates.

exposure.note: The recording has a single exposure; no exposure pairs exist, so the detector-linearity term is absent from both arms.

base_state.aberration: CalibratedBench static map: nominal bench state + calibration.aberration

fields.l1: mean relative L1 of the gain-matched prepared frames
fields.ncc: mean zero-mean NCC of the prepared frames
fields.l1_raw: relative L1 of the unit-sum frames as stored (pedestal kept)
fields.ncc_raw: NCC of the unit-sum frames as stored (pedestal kept)

scoring.note: Only l1/ncc/gain are comparable with calibrate_summary.json; the *_raw fields keep the camera pedestal in view.

duplicates.lookup: first recorded frame per exact command phase
duplicates.note: leak_free_holdout excludes holdout rows whose exact command also appears in train; it is a diagnostic, the frozen split stays primary
